title: Quick Pro GR:ONE official-enterprise-store Taobao listing
notes: Each exact option was selected before recording its price. The listing labels the six complete bikes only as configurations one through six and its visible detail panels do not map those labels to a component package, so none is assigned to the GRX Di2 candidate. Listing panels independently support Toray T1100 + M65 carbon, a painted size-M frame weight of 919 g including accessories with ±5% tolerance, 459 g fork, 169 g seatpost, T47-68, UDH, Monolith cockpit construction and 700×45C maximum. Raw listing media and hashes remain in the local immutable evidence archive outside Git.
